index_types.name: FlatIP
index_types.description: Exact inner product search with L2-normalized vectors (cosine similarity)
index_types.speed: Slow for large datasets, exact results
index_types.use_case: Small to medium datasets where exact results are required

index_types.name: HNSW
index_types.description: Hierarchical Navigable Small World - approximate nearest neighbor search
index_types.use_case: Large datasets where approximate results are acceptable
